provenance: shape and seed case adapted from addy-osmani-agent-skills/evals (planning-and-task-breakdown.json; notifications-spec fixture); merged-skill expectations added

evals.prompt: Break the attached notifications spec into an executable plan.
evals.expected_output: A plan of parts with status lines, ordered tracer-bullet tasks with acceptance criteria, verification steps and dependencies, approved via the quiz round before publication
expectations: Every task has acceptance criteria and an explicit verification step
Tasks are ordered by dependency and sliced vertically (tracer bullets), not by layer
Each part carries its > Status: planned line and a closing checkpoint
The breakdown is presented for approval (granularity, blocking edges, merge/split) before anything is published
No implementation code is written during planning

evals.prompt: Turn the approved spec into tickets an agent can pick up from our tracker backlog — they may sit for weeks.
evals.expected_output: Tracer-bullet tickets with What to build, acceptance criteria, ready-for-agent, and blocking edges, written durable (no file paths) per the freshness dial
expectations: The freshness dial is applied: tickets that may sit carry no file paths or line numbers
Each ticket states the end-to-end behaviour it delivers and its Blocked by edges (or none)
Publication follows the resolved tracker: native blocking links on a real tracker, one file per ticket locally
The quiz round runs before publication
